reason: Hypothesis A is more specific and testable: it explicitly ties the coercivity increase to a strain-assisted directional ordering mechanism on a lattice-mismatched substrate, defines a clear baseline (as-deposited fcc FeCoNi), and sets a precise falsification criterion (order-of-magnitude coercivity increase plus evidence of a low-symmetry phase). Hypothesis B is vaguer, lacks the explicit substrate-strain coupling, and its predicted outcome range ('up to one to three orders of magnitude') is less decisive.
